about.title: About Us
about.aboutText: Welcome to NECYL English School. Founded with a vision to bridge the gap between local learners and global opportunities, we have spent the last decade refining our pedagogical approach to ensure every student feels supported, challenged, and inspired.
about.missionText: To provide accessible, high-quality English language education that empowers students to achieve their academic and professional goals.
about.visionText: To be the leading English language school in Myanmar, recognized for our innovative teaching methods and student success.
about.founderMessage: Welcome to NECYL. We believe that language is a bridge to endless opportunities. Our goal is to equip our students with the skills they need to confidently navigate the global landscape.
